overview: The Upper Caverns mark the transition from Paludal’s natural tunnels into shadow‑altered depths.
details: Bandits have carved out fortified camps, fungal forests have grown into towering structures, and shadow anomalies distort sound, light, and movement.
hooks: A bandit warlord attempts to unify the lower raider groups.
Shadow anomalies create temporary rifts that displace creatures.
Smugglers report a new tunnel that wasn’t there the day before.
